pairing: within seed and neighborhood; compare every arm and checkpoint on identical panel identities

bootstrap.interval: paired neighborhood 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles conditional on each seed and fixed panel

seed_gates.material_continuous_gain: step-120 mean SHAM-LOW minus SHAM delta_p_new >= +0.020
seed_gates.direction: SHAM-LOW correct-direction rate >= 0.99 and no more than 0.01 below concurrent SHAM
seed_gates.preservation: SHAM-LOW A_old >= SHAM - 0.05 overall and >= SHAM - 0.10 in every family
seed_gates.q_operating_point_seed_pass: same-seed conjunction of material continuous gain, direction, material locality advantage over DUP, and preservation
seed_gates.q_operating_point_cohort_label: at least 2 of the same 3 seed-level joint predicates pass
seed_gates.q_stiff_coupling_seed: same seed has material continuous gain; each SHAM-LOW L1 differs from concurrent DUP by <=10% relative to DUP; both MAP-flip-rate differences are <=0.05 absolute
seed_gates.q_stiff_coupling_cohort_label: at least 2 of 3 same-seed joint predicates pass
seed_gates.q_map_response_seed: both F_new and Strict improve by >=0.10 versus SHAM in same seed
